tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Canvas: app background, behind hairline grids, inputs on surfaces.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Surface: every grid cell, panel, table, sidebar, dialog.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised: row and button hover, kbd keys, skeletons, code blocks.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Selected: active nav item, selected row, pressed segment, open menu trigger.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Faint hairline: row separators inside tables and lists, background grid.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairline: the structural 1px grid between cells, panel and overlay borders, table header rule. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Control border (3:1 on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200): inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, crosshair marks.

tokens.name: fg-100
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface (bg-000 to bg-300).

tokens.name: fg-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells that are not the row's key, inactive nav items. On bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: fg-300
tokens.usage: Muted text: meta, timestamps, column headers, eyebrows. On bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: fg-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Monochrome accent: primary button fill, active tab bar, checked controls, chart emphasis.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (17:1 or more).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 1px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success / done / healthy: text and status shapes (circle). On bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok badges, banners and diff additions.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning: budget at 80 %, expiring domains, degraded checks. Shape: triangle.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error, failed run, destructive actions, budget stop. Shape: square.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind error badges, banners, diff removals.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Running / in progress / neutral notices. Shape: pulsing dot.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind info badges and banners.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Needs a human: approval waiting, beacons, the approval count. Shape: diamond. The only hue that may draw the eye unprompted.

tokens.name: signal-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind approval cards' header and signal badges.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines in override diffs.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines in override diffs.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 / the highlighted series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 / comparison (prior period).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Document previews (invoices, PDFs): paper is white in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: module title on overview pages, login.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and dialog titles, mail subject in the reader.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and section titles, agent names, table row keys.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Der Entwurf ist bereit zur Freigabe.
styles.usage: Running text in comfortable density, chat messages, mail bodies.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Default UI text in compact density: tables, lists, nav, controls.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text in small buttons, badge text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under fields, meta lines, helper text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, table column headers, grid cell labels. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Logs, tool calls, IDs, DNS values, email addresses in lists.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, amounts in dense tables, shortcuts.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: KPI values in stat cells. Always tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and kbd groups.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact horizontal cell and control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid cell padding, comfortable control padding, page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Cell padding on overview grids; background-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Login and onboarding vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything structural: cells, panels, tables, dialogs, sheets, cards.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, badges, kbd, switches, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only status dots and radio buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, command palette. Always paired with a line-200 border.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Row height for tables, lists and nav items in compact density.

tokens.name: row-comfy
tokens.usage: Row height in comfortable density.

tokens.name: control-dense
tokens.usage: Button and input height in compact density.

tokens.name: control-comfy
tokens.usage: Button and input height in comfortable density.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width, expanded.

tokens.name: sidebar-w-collapsed
tokens.usage: Sidebar width, icon-only.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default Lucide icon size.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and dense table cells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and grid line.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets, toasts entering.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: The only easing curve.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, top bar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack.

tokens.name: z-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette.

component.note: Component knobs: the shape of buttons, fields, badges and panels per theme. Change a theme here; a new theme sets all of them.

tokens.name: button-radius
tokens.usage: Corners of buttons (Button, IconButton). One knob for a theme's button shape.

tokens.name: field-radius
tokens.usage: Corners of inputs and selects.

tokens.name: badge-radius
tokens.usage: Corners of badges and chips.

tokens.name: panel-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a panel: a cell of the hairline grid, a section, a side column.

tokens.name: panel-border
tokens.usage: Border colour of a panel standing on its own; transparent where panels float.

tokens.name: panel-radius
tokens.usage: Corners of a panel. Pro: square cells of the hairline grid.

tokens.name: panel-shadow
tokens.usage: Resting shadow of a panel. Pro: none, the hairlines divide.

tokens.name: panel-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a panel.

tokens.name: panel-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a grid: the hairline in Pro, air between cards in Halo.
